title: The Dashboard pattern teaches a charting bridge the kit replaced, and does not describe its own demo
foundBy: an independent reviewer agent, asked to assess whether the patterns had drifted from the design system
details:
`patterns/Dashboard.md` devotes roughly 200 lines to a hand-rolled `useChartTokens()` hook that reads computed CSS variables, plus Recharts-specific tooltip and legend recipes. `useChartTokens` exists nowhere but that document. The shipped answer is `useChartTheme()`, which `patterns/Chart.md` makes its first rule, and Dashboard.md never mentions `useChartTheme`, `ChartFrame` or `ChartTooltip` in its prose even though its own frontmatter lists the latter two as related.

The hook it teaches is also wrong in the way Chart.md warns about: it re-reads on render without subscribing to the theme flip, so a chart drawn with it does not follow a light and dark toggle.

Separately, its Composition section describes Card plus Recharts line, bar and pie charts. The demo uses no Recharts at all: it hand-draws SVG with `useChartTheme` and `ChartTooltip`. The `ResponsiveContainer` sizing guidance describes something the demo does not do.

A reader following this document builds a second, divergent theming bridge and never meets ChartFrame's loading, error and empty states.
